decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/The proposed  flank extension would, by reason of its size and  position  in relation to the adjoining neighbouring residential properties create an adverse impact on the amenities currently being enjoyed by the adjoining occupiers including loss of light.   The proposal is therefore contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Guidance, "Residential Extension Guidelines".     

2/The proposed  flank extension would, by reason of its lack of setback from the main frontage of the house  in relation to the adjoining neighbouring residential properties create an adverse impact on the street scene.   The proposal is therefore contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Guidance, "Residential Extension Guidelines".     

.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to house.
